recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-13289 unless a future generated v2/v3 terminology pipeline outside current build scope reintroduces a date-valued deprecated property URI.
issue_request: FHIR-13289 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CodeSystem correction for STU3. It reported that generated v2 and v3 code systems used a dateTime property with code deprecated and URI http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties#deprecated where the deprecation-date property should be deprecationDate.
initial_application: Jira's application comment cites svn revision 12611. The corresponding migrated git-svn commit 32744075fc34c3ddb366d6679391a6344eda2012 (#13289 - fix deprecated URL) changed the old R4 CodeSystemUtilities helper to emit deprecationDate for date-valued deprecation properties and to recognize that property when determining deprecation. That old implementation path is no longer present in current source.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes the concept-properties CodeSystem source. Current source/codesystem/codesystem-concept-properties.xml defines the legacy deprecated property as deprecated and the preferred deprecationDate property as dateTime, while source/codesystem/codesystem-notes.xml explains the http://hl7.org/fhir/concept-properties# prefix and lists deprecationDate. Related combined-branch reconciliations for FHIR-12312 and FHIR-37849 already account for the later concept-properties documentation and deprecated/deprecationDate alignment context.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Searches of active source, current terminology inputs under tools/tx, and current implementation directories found no remaining concept-properties#deprecated URI use for a date-valued deprecationDate property, so changing current FHIR core source would be redundant or out of build scope.
